user_feedback.first_window: 回答完整但有卡顿；用户确认周围还有说话或播放声

selected_request.selection: First new complete request following the quiet-window instruction, with a matching full-playback ACK. It was the sole new request observed when the user feedback arrived; later requests remain separate.
selected_request.script_match_limitation: The observer compares local_transcription.text, but its exported character count was zero throughout. The false script flag is not evidence that the user spoke a different sentence.

timing_interpretation: The 8418.424 ms total starts at foreground job execution and ends at first audio queued. Physical end-of-speech and acoustic first-sound timestamps are unavailable.
LLM and TTS RPC durations include transport, host dispatch and inference; same-request host prefill/decode and pure network RTT were not exposed.

The 887.638 ms difference is an arithmetic residual after four named stages, not an independently instrumented network or scheduling measurement. Admission, route and analysis enqueue are parts of remaining work.
first_chunk_emitted_ms is an emission-callback completion marker and is not used as acoustic playback onset.
Observed state transitions, full ACK and rearming are 1 Hz samples. Their difference is not an exact playback-finish-to-microphone latency.
This is one reviewed foreground request under metadata observation; no stable percentile or before/after speed claim.

selected_audio.software_metric_definition: GStreamer code adds zero PCM and increments this counter when active, ready, not paused, not final, and content queue empty. Its position within speech versus leading/trailing waiting is not determined by this probe.

window_health.requested_owner_followup: Completed in round2/FINAL_STATE.json. Later observation mono15163.075213721 confirmed enabled=true, WAITING_SPEECH and microphone_open=true on the same startup and boot. Target-request rearming was also independently observed true at 14488.239.

later_owner_followup.scope: Later followup, not part of the 180-second observation window. Its cumulative counters do not replace the window increments.
